lessons.trigger_condition: V399 governs UI/PWA/runtime composition above V398, but card measurement/grading verification, KR/JP/US card-market freshness/source health, and collaboration/promo/event coverage are not explicit peer surfaces in one evidence-aware autonomous goal portfolio.
lessons.prevention_rule: V400 must preserve V399/V398 as mandatory upstream gates, score UI, card measurement, card market and collaboration/event surfaces only from local operational evidence, treat missing or stale evidence as revalidation demand rather than success, select the largest verified deficit, apply at most one V400-owned canonical V373 declarative canary without overlapping V397/V398 experiments, release verified gains or exactly roll back material regressions, and keep source-level improvements as non-executable protected PR/CI candidates with domain-specific validation.
validation_required: V400 main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py for tablet_gpt
runtime manifest preserves V399/V398 and includes V400 plus V400 dashboard assets
UI surface consumes V399 UI/PWA/runtime health only
card-measurement surface requires measurement runtime assets and verification evidence and never invents grades
card-market surface uses market_prices freshness, source/link health and KR/JP/US coverage and never invents prices
collaboration/event surface uses promo_events freshness, official/cross source health and coverage and never invents event facts
missing or stale surface evidence lowers confidence and prioritizes revalidation
surface steering uses canonical V373 declarative primitives only
V397/V398/V400 experimental capability overlap is blocked
V400 canary uses verified surface score delta for release or exact rollback
repeated source-level gaps remain non-executable protected PR/CI candidates
dashboard is read-only and exposes the four requested domains
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V400 autonomously diagnoses, prioritizes and canary-tests bounded declarative operational steering across UI, card measurement, card market and collaboration/event surfaces. It does not generate or rewrite source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass V399/V398 or earlier gates, infer market direction, invent prices/grades/event facts, import peer weights/raw state, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
